plugins.mainwp-child: remote management: a MainWP dashboard can install and run code; disconnect the site from the dashboard
plugins.core-rollback: rewrites core on disk, which production cannot (DISALLOW_FILE_MODS)
plugins.wp-rollback: rewrites plugins on disk, which production cannot (DISALLOW_FILE_MODS)
plugins.download-plugin: packages installed code for download; plugins come from Composer
plugins.wpvivid-backuprestore: backups are the cluster's (backup-core and the R2 mirror)
plugins.wpvivid-backup-pro: backups are the cluster's (backup-core and the R2 mirror)
plugins.index-wp-mysql-for-speed: rewrites table keys; the platform owns the schema
plugins.wordfence: writes firewall files to wp-content; the edge (Cloudflare WAF) and the read-only tree replace it
plugins.sucuri-scanner: writes to wp-content; the edge and the read-only tree replace it
plugins.patchstack: the vulnerability feed is wordpress-nix audit (Wordfence Intelligence)
plugins.litespeed-cache: no LiteSpeed under FrankenPHP; HTML caching is a Cloudflare Cache Rule
plugins.wp-super-cache: page cache; HTML caching is a Cloudflare Cache Rule
plugins.w3-total-cache: page cache; HTML caching is a Cloudflare Cache Rule
plugins.wp-fastest-cache: page cache; HTML caching is a Cloudflare Cache Rule
plugins.flying-press: page cache writing to wp-content; HTML caching is a Cloudflare Cache Rule
plugins.wp-cloudflare-page-cache: page cache writing to wp-content; HTML caching is a Cloudflare Cache Rule
plugins.redis-cache: object-cache drop-in; the platform runs no Redis
plugins.health-check: troubleshooting mode installs a mu-plugin at run time

jwt-auth.reason: Avunu's jwt-auth fork collides with the wordpress.org slug; Access and two-factor replace it

plugins.woo-update-manager: WooCommerce.com updater; extensions are committed code
plugins.gitium: v2: wp-admin no longer commits code
plugins.webp-express: writes converted images and .htaccess into wp-content
plugins.xcloud-cloudflare-edge-cache: legacy host cache integration; cutover snapshots and disables the zone's cache rules
